name: Birth Pulse
description: Send a first pulse into a newly fallen ally to restart the heart within the window.

name: Birth Cord
description: Throw a cord of birth qi round the foe that draws them back whenever they flee.

name: Birth Lance
description: Thrust a lance of new-born qi that opens the guard and sprouts in the wound.

name: Birth Mending
description: Mend a grievous wound on an ally as if the flesh had just been made.

name: Birth Shell
description: Grow a shell from the core that drinks a blow and turns it into new strength.

name: Birth Leap
description: Leap from one spot to another in the flash of a new beginning.

name: Birth Gift
description: Give an ally a measure of the user's new-born strength for the length of a fight.

name: Birth Eye
description: See the full cycle behind any body: its former lives, its health and the turn it has reached.

name: Birth Banner
description: Raise a banner of rebirth that lifts the fallen near it and strengthens the living.

name: Birth Storm
description: Whirl a storm of new-born qi that scours foes and mends every ally within it.

name: Birth Tide
description: Raise a tide of rebirth that calls back every ally fallen within the window across a great field.

name: Unwritten Return
description: Undo one death from the same hour, so the person never died, a thing no energy mechanic explains.

name: Boundless Knitting
description: Pour mending qi through a group of allies until every wound has begun to close.

name: Boundless Purge
description: Purge poison, taint and curse from a whole line of allies with one slow breath.

name: Boundless Raise
description: Raise a newly fallen ally and several nearby with the same turn of the wheel.

name: Boundless Strike
description: Strike with the weight of every past blow the wheel has carried.

name: Boundless Sink
description: Sink the most violent blow into the wheel and keep its force for the next strike.

name: Boundless Passage
description: Pass through the foe's line and arrive wherever the wheel has turned the user.

name: Boundless Insight
description: Read the full unwritten history of a body, a blade or a ruin from its qi.

name: Boundless Gift
description: Give a host of allies a draught of the wheel's store, each gaining strength.

name: Boundless Herald
description: Stand as the herald of the wheel, lifting the fallen and strengthening the living.

name: Boundless Roll
description: Roll the wheel over a field to crush foes and mend allies in one pass.

name: Boundless Pledge
description: Seal a pledge on a dying ally so the wheel waits until the fight is done.

name: Boundless Recall
description: Raise every ally fallen within the window across a whole battlefield, the widest ceiling of the divine tier.

name: Deathless Name
description: Tie a person's name to the wheel so death cannot take them while it is spoken, a thing no energy mechanic explains.
